title: K-Means++ Algorithm: Solving the Random Initialization Trap in Clustering

cues.en: Instructor: Hello and welcome back to the course.
cues.zh: 講師：大家好，歡迎回到課程。

cues.en: In today's tutorial, we're going to look at K-Means ++ and understand how it works and why it's used.
cues.zh: 今天這堂課要介紹 K-means++，了解它如何運作，以及為什麼要使用它。

cues.en: So here we've got our data set and let's say we want to apply k-means.
cues.zh: 這裡有一組資料，假設我們想套用 K-means。

cues.en: And for arguments sake, let's say that the centroids are initialized in in the following way.
cues.zh: 為了方便說明，假設質心的初始化位置如下。

cues.en: Then once we apply k-means and all the steps take place, we will end up with these three clusters.
cues.zh: 執行 K-means，完成所有步驟後，就會得到這三個群組。

cues.en: So that's quite straightforward.
cues.zh: 這很容易理解。

cues.en: But now let's say we have the same data set and we apply k-means again but because the centroids are initialized at random let's say they were initialized in the following way
cues.zh: 但現在假設對同一組資料再次執行 K-means，由於質心是隨機初始化的，這次假設初始化位置如下，

cues.en: and then once we apply k-means, we will get a different set of three clusters.
cues.zh: 執行 K-means 後，就會得到另一組不同的三個群組。

cues.en: And this is not good.
cues.zh: 這就不好了。

cues.en: The results are different in these two runs of the same machine learning model of the k-means.
cues.zh: 同一個 K-means 機器學習模型，執行兩次卻得到不同結果。

cues.en: And they're only different because the initialization of the centroids was different.
cues.zh: 結果不同，唯一原因就是質心的初始化位置不同。

cues.en: We didn't change anything else.
cues.zh: 其他東西都沒有改變。

cues.en: And this is called the Random Initialization Trap.
cues.zh: 這就叫做隨機初始化陷阱。

cues.en: Why is this a bad thing?
cues.zh: 為什麼這不好呢？

cues.en: Well, two reasons.
cues.zh: 有兩個原因。

cues.en: The main reason is, that when you run a machine learning model like in this case, like clustering you want it to be deterministic.
cues.zh: 主要原因是，當你執行像分群這類機器學習模型時，會希望結果具有確定性。

cues.en: You want the result to be the same.
cues.zh: 你希望結果相同。

cues.en: You don't want to get different results just because of some random installation at the start of the algorithm.
cues.zh: 你不希望只因為演算法開始時的某個隨機初始化，就得到不同結果。

cues.en: This model is meant to tell you something about your business, something about the problem you have at hand, how your customers or how these data points are clustered.
cues.zh: 這個模型應該告訴你有關業務或眼前問題的資訊，例如顧客或這些資料點如何分群。

cues.en: The insight shouldn't depend on some random installation.
cues.zh: 這些洞見不應取決於某次隨機初始化。

cues.en: It's an insight about the project or the business or this data set.
cues.zh: 它應該反映這個專案、業務或資料集本身。

cues.en: So that's a big concern.
cues.zh: 所以這是很大的疑慮。

cues.en: And the second thing is that if you look at the data set itself in with before the clusters applied, you can see you kind of intuitively see what the clusters should be.
cues.zh: 第二，如果在套用分群之前觀察資料集本身，其實可以憑直覺看出群組應該長什麼樣子。

cues.en: And it looks like the k-means at the top is showing us the correct clusters.
cues.zh: 看起來上方的 K-means 顯示的是正確群組。

cues.en: The k-means at the bottom on the other hand, is not showing us the best set of clusters.
cues.zh: 相較之下，下方的 K-means 並沒有顯示最佳的一組群組。

cues.en: So that's what we want to avoid and that's what K-Means ++ is designed to combat.
cues.zh: 這就是我們想避免的情況，也是 K-means++ 設計要解決的問題。

cues.en: It's basically the same as K-Means, but it adds some steps at the beginning to initialize centroids in a certain way.
cues.zh: 它基本上和 K-means 相同，只是在開頭增加一些步驟，用特定方式初始化質心。

cues.en: So let's have a look.
cues.zh: 我們來看看。

cues.en: We'll first look at the steps and then we'll look at it visually.
cues.zh: 先看步驟，再用圖示說明。

cues.en: So Step One is the first centroid is chosen at random.
cues.zh: 第一步，隨機選出第一個質心。

cues.en: Step Two is that for every data point we compute the distance to the nearest of the already selected centroids.
cues.zh: 第二步，對每個資料點計算它與已選質心中最近者的距離。

cues.en: Step Three is we then use a weighted random selection to pick out the next centroid based on the distance to the existing centroids.
cues.zh: 第三步，根據與既有質心的距離，使用加權隨機抽選來選出下一個質心。

cues.en: And then we repeat steps, then two and three until we have all our centroids ready and then we just apply the standard k-means clustering.
cues.zh: 接著重複第二和第三步，直到所有質心都準備好，再執行標準的 K-means 分群。

cues.en: Now this might all seem a little bit too much right now but let's have a look at it visually.
cues.zh: 現在聽起來可能有點複雜，但我們用圖來看看。

cues.en: So here's our data set.
cues.zh: 這是我們的資料集。

cues.en: Let's say that the first centroid was initialized here at random.
cues.zh: 假設第一個質心隨機初始化在這裡。

cues.en: Now what we're going to do, or what K-Means ++ will do, is it will measure the distance from every remaining data point to this centroid and then it'll take that distance,
cues.zh: 接著我們，也就是 K-means++，會量出每個剩餘資料點到這個質心的距離，再取這個距離值，

cues.en: the value of the distance, and it'll square that value.
cues.zh: 把它平方。

cues.en: So now we will select the next centroid at random but it'll be a weighted random selection.
cues.zh: 接下來隨機選取下一個質心，但這會是加權隨機抽選。

cues.en: So it'll be weighted by this distance squared.
cues.zh: 權重就是這個距離的平方。

cues.en: So the centroid in the top right, the furthest away, has the highest chance of being picked.
cues.zh: 因此，右上角最遠的那個點，被選為質心的機率最高。

cues.en: And for argument sake, let's say that it was selected.
cues.zh: 為了方便說明，就假設選中了它。

cues.en: Now, what happens next is for, we do the procedure again.
cues.zh: 接下來再做一次這個流程。

cues.en: We measure the distance to the closest centroid.
cues.zh: 量出到最近質心的距離。

cues.en: For each data point, we measure distance to the closest centroid, right?
cues.zh: 對每個資料點，都量出到最近質心的距離，對吧？

cues.en: So these would be these ones for the ones on the left.
cues.zh: 所以左邊這些點，量的是到這個質心的距離。

cues.en: And the ones on the right were closest to the blue centroid.
cues.zh: 而右邊的點離藍色質心最近。

cues.en: And again, we would square these distances and the probability of a centroid being, or a data point being picked as a next centroid
cues.zh: 再次將這些距離平方，而某個資料點被選為下一個質心的機率，

cues.en: will be proportional to that distance squared.
cues.zh: 會與這個距離的平方成正比。

cues.en: So for argument's sake, let's say the bottom one selected was selected because it has indeed the highest probability.
cues.zh: 為了方便說明，假設選中了下方這個點，因為它的機率確實最高。

cues.en: So there we go.
cues.zh: 就是這樣。

cues.en: That's how centroids would be initialized.
cues.zh: 質心會以這種方式初始化。

cues.en: And as a result, we would get these three clusters.
cues.zh: 結果就會得到這三個群組。

cues.en: So one thing to note here is that K-Means ++ does not guarantee that there will not be an issue
cues.zh: 這裡要注意，K-means++ 並不保證初始化時絕對不會發生問題，

cues.en: in terms of initialization because it is done at random.
cues.zh: 因為它仍然是隨機進行的。

cues.en: But because it's done in a weighted random fashion, the chances of that happening are much lower.
cues.zh: 但因為採用加權隨機方式，發生問題的機率會低很多。

cues.en: And so this does indeed help with the two problems that we saw in the random installation trap.
cues.zh: 因此，它確實有助於解決剛才在隨機初始化陷阱中看到的兩個問題。

cues.en: So there we go.
cues.zh: 就是這樣。

cues.en: That's what K-Means ++ is all about and that's why we use it.
cues.zh: 這就是 K-means++ 的概念，也是我們使用它的原因。

cues.en: I look forward to seeing you back here next time.
cues.zh: 期待下次在這裡再見。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在那之前，祝你享受機器學習的樂趣。
